about: The secreta of the formulary “Saint Stephen, the First Martyr” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Receive our offerings, O Lord, in memory of Your saints, that, as their passion has given them eternal glory, so may this sacrificial act free us from guilt. Through our Lord. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God,
